## Getting Started

To work with this project, please follow these steps below:

1. Download flutter: https://docs.flutter.dev/
   ++ Version: 3.29.3
2. **Global Melos Installation**
   ```bash
   dart pub global activate melos

## Run project

1. **Melos build**
   ```bash
   melos bootstrap && melos run build
2. **See options on title bar of AndroidStudio IDE**
   ++ Flutter Run -> saa2025: To run the app
   ++ Flutter Run -> generate:build_runner: To build modules
   1d_runner: To build modules
3. **Generate resource**
   ```bash
    python3 ../app/assets/image.py
    dart format ../app/lib/r.dart

4. **Build release IOS**
   ```bash
   cd ../app
   flutter build ipa --release

5. **Build release Android**
   ```bash
   cd ../app
   flutter build apk --release
